scope: Current-release development replications; not general enterprise efficacy evidence
treatment: Luna xhigh, published native MCP, bundled skill, agent-authored SQL/card and live Jev policy judgments
control: Same Luna, 27 Superset analytical tools, owner policy, workspace, SQL/code and automation abilities, without SignalWeave
setup_boundary: Actual isolated terminal wizard, Codex registration and skill after research-helper archive extraction/copy; not a new public-curl-installer or real-human novice study
operator_boundary: The isolated actor uses a research-only operator callback to forward its own query file to the real native query-import CLI. This substitutes for the host terminal access an ordinary Codex user would grant; it supplies no analytical SQL or card. It is not an extra public MCP tool.

subsequent_runtime_guard_check.scope: New research-harness guard exercised against the actual published rc5 bundle, after the completed studies; not retroactive immutability proof

timing_scope: Analyst trajectory wall time includes business discovery, card/procedure onboarding and recurrence; excludes release download, wizard/preflight and independent review. Arms ran serially on the same host with shared source/cache conditions; differences are descriptive, not causal effects.

northstar.source: Real local Superset over the finalized synthetic warehouse, not an as-known-at-the-time backtest
northstar.unit: Two repetitions of the same seven-period company task, four trajectories; periods are not independent enterprises
northstar.routine_delivery: Dispatch digest every period, including ignore; separate Data Operations handoff for the missing dates

original_pair.status: Closed research-quota-censored diagnostic; original records not rescored
original_pair.reader_result: Both sets' core figures/routes supported; treatment messages longer. Three later native checks were blocked by the nine-request research ceiling, not Jev. No clean reliability or efficiency comparison.

fresh_pair.status: Both trajectories closed and independently reviewed; no research-provider rejection
fresh_pair.reader_method: Independent Luna reviewer prepared rubric before original label-C/D inbox packets; knew source oracle, not traces, mapping or timing. Unedited tooling clues make blinding partial.
reader_findings: Both delivered seven digests, the qualifying investigation and missing-date handoff; no core claim contradicted the oracle.
The SignalWeave run supplied a copy-verified 12-record damage worklist matching every oracle ID and an explicit follow-up; baseline supplied neither worklist nor attachments.
Both sent unnecessary monitoring-metadata questions to Data Operations. SignalWeave also sent evaluation-process commentary to Dispatch, an audience mismatch.

The initial reader oracle did not verify supplemental daily/late/delivery-time/record-attribute claims; the separate posthoc warehouse check below expands that coverage. Supporting copies still do not establish recipient opens.

supplemental_validation.method: Posthoc independent read-only warehouse SQL plus direct CSV reconciliation; original oracle and reader review unchanged
supplemental_validation.result: No contradiction in the quantitative claims checked; all 30 CSV rows matched live damaged-source records on every included field. These are coverage units, not a global accuracy percentage.
supplemental_validation.limits: Current warehouse contents do not independently reconstruct historical source versions. No delivery-monitor entry does not establish a delivery defect or freshness. Source tables do not certify owner policy or human receipt/use.

fresh_pair.query_accounting: Independent read-only SQLLab metadata matches all captured query IDs: baseline 25, treatment 20 (12 direct plus eight native reads). Original pair was baseline 12 versus treatment 17. Counts do not measure scanned bytes or warehouse cost.
fresh_pair.conclusion: Reviewed-card recurrence and a useful investigation handoff work in this known scenario. Treatment took 18.2% longer and more uncached frontier tokens; no speed/cost, fewer-message, general superiority or Jev-specific causal benefit is established.

harbor.status: Both three-phase trajectories and the separate owner-activation handoff are closed. Independent source, process and partially label-blinded message reviews are retained with explicit corrections; no general comparative advantage established.
harbor.source: Company MCP over isolated synthetic SQLite event-history snapshots, not a vendor-cloud connector
harbor.people: Five model-simulated company roles, not real humans

baseline_process_observations.later_weekly_operations_briefs: Initial setup used Operations. During recurrence the agent asked the owner, who explicitly authorized queue-lead/duty-manager for Monday briefs and weekly threshold-review drafts during the 28-cutoff study. Later messages followed that approved change; they are not missed approved handoffs.
baseline_process_observations.corrected_interpretation: The earlier public/process interpretation called the absent Operations messages a routing/intent-persistence miss. Closed-packet review found the later explicit owner consent, which supersedes that interpretation. Original records and prior Git revisions remain; do not claim this as a SignalWeave advantage. Role fidelity and changed owner choices require separate treatment.
baseline_process_observations.interpretation: Process completion is not business success. Late simulated feedback was research-resource-censored; no clean full-journey comparative efficiency claim.

treatment_onboarding.interpretation: Closed setup trajectories, not proof of later recurrence. The raw-MCP bridge and six opt-in domain-context tools were enabled; this is not the default Superset-only setup surface.

operator_assisted_owner_handoff.reason: Weekly card approval covered evaluation, not recurring delivery. The original independent recurrence BLOCK is retained.
operator_assisted_owner_handoff.method: One separately reviewed ordinary simulated-owner clarification; no source, policy, card, procedure or native status edits, no analytical model or Jev call, no business delivery.
operator_assisted_owner_handoff.result: The actual simulated owner explicitly authorized due weekly local manual-review drafts to Operations within the bounded historical study, excluding external sends and production scheduling.
operator_assisted_owner_handoff.interpretation: Operator-assisted onboarding completion, not zero-touch onboarding or an original preregistered stage. Include this extra usage in any whole-journey accounting. A separate new independent admission permitted the subsequent bounded recurrence; the original BLOCK is unchanged.

treatment_recurring_process.interpretation: All 28 source cutoffs completed. These are process/usage facts, not an accuracy, usefulness, equal-workload speed or enterprise-readiness claim.

closed_review.policy_revision: Treatment daily v2 receipts cover February 23–March 8; approved v3 covers March 9–22. Both monitors remain registered. A pre-approval draft snapshot is not the final native status.
closed_review.source_check: 81 explicit set/row/time-context reconciliation assertions had no mismatch among compared values. Unverified fields and blank values remain unverified, not imputed. Assertions are not an accuracy score.
closed_review.reader_result: Both trajectories have useful supported handoffs and reader-access gaps: recurring detail is mostly new-item deltas/counts rather than a full current worklist, and final attachment use is unproven. Baseline corrected an early weekly population-scope ambiguity. No completed ticket action or real-human usability is established.
closed_review.review_corrections: Original review and two amendments retained. Cross-packet approval attribution was retired; a draft confirmation snapshot could not establish final native status; actual post-approval results show v3 approved. Baseline's later caller ValueErrors were real trace events absent from the person-reply ledger, not an invented explanation. Later owner-authorized weekly routing is not a baseline miss.
closed_review.comparison_limit: More time and frontier input were observed with treatment; approved policies differ and baseline feedback is cap-censored. No clean equal-workload efficiency or Jev-specific causal claim.

harbor.readiness_limit: The saved baseline query does not establish event completeness; whole-week rates are withheld. The weekly threshold branch is unproven.
harbor.policy_comparability: Grade each arm against its actual owner-approved scope. Treatment already includes overdue resolution follow-up alongside the primary unanswered first-response queue; baseline initially focuses on unanswered first response until the dated owner change. The treatment owner also permits an explicitly caveated observed-cohort ratio that the baseline owner withholds as a whole-week rate. These differences prevent a simple equal-workload or common-decision-label comparison.
harbor.quiet_state_limit: Every daily cutoff has qualifying work; this cohort cannot establish quiet-day suppression.

proof_boundaries: Adaptive repetitions on known history are not independent holdouts or statistical significance.
The Superset lab permits SELECT through SQLLab with DML disabled. It is not a viewer-only Preset integration or production RBAC test.
This whole-stack comparison does not isolate Jev from the skill, card context, retrieval or frontier behavior.
Deliveries are simulated local inboxes, not Slack/email or proof that a human read or acted.
Billing cost is unknown; tokens and SQL counts are not monetary savings.
All 208 copied runtime files matched rc5 in a separate post-setup check; these studies did not prospectively freeze the runtime inventory.
Raw traces remain in ignored artifacts/workflow-proof-2026-10-20. Hashes alone are not public reproduction of those private records.
The new-company quiet/ambiguity transfer stage is not admitted or executed. Enterprise readiness is not established.
